problem:
Which of the following represents the solution to the system of linear equations given below?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}2x=5y \\ x=-2\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
worked_solution:
First, we reorganize the equations so that they are in the right order, to get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}2x-5y=0 \\ x=-2.\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we can represent this system of equations in the form $Ax=b:$

$$
[\begin{aligned}2 & -5 \\ 1 & 0\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -2\end{aligned}].
$$

To find the solution, we need to calculate the inverse of the coefficient matrix $A=[\begin{aligned}2 & -5 \\ 1 & 0\end{aligned}].$ This gives

$$
\begin{aligned}{A}^{-1} & =\frac{1}{2\cdot 0-(-5)\cdot 1}[\begin{aligned}0 & 5 \\ -1 & 2\end{aligned}] \\  & =\frac{1}{5}[\begin{aligned}0 & 5 \\ -1 & 2\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

We can now find the solution to this system as:

$$
\begin{aligned}x & ={A}^{-1}b \\  & =\frac{1}{5}[\begin{aligned}0 & 5 \\ -1 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}0 \\ -2\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
